description.zh: 在 Operit 中与 AI 对玩 UNO 卡牌游戏。AI 通过工具出牌，用户通过界面选择卡牌或放弃。全状态由 JSON 在 cleanOnExit/uno 目录控制。
description.en: Play UNO card game with AI in Operit. The AI plays via tools, the user plays via the UI. Full state is JSON-controlled under cleanOnExit/uno.

description.zh: UNO 卡牌对战工具：提供游戏实例管理、出牌、查看手牌、弃牌抽牌等工具。
description.en: UNO card game tools: game instance management, card play, hand viewing, and draw/abandon tools.
